_: WHAT SHIPPED. A film is a build artefact -- scenes.json, the art in this folder and the
app's narration rebuild any cut byte-identically, with no API calls -- so the master does
not belong in git (docs/01 §6). That leaves exactly one fact about a film that is NOT
reproducible from this repo, and this file is where it goes: WHICH CUT IS LIVE.
Without it nothing can answer 'is the film on the channel the current story?'. That is not
hypothetical: the 720p below sat two cuts behind its own master, six seconds short, and
there was no place to notice.
Update it when you publish. `duration` is the measured length of the file that went out;
`expected` is what the current scenes.json plus the app's narration predict, so the two
drifting apart is the signal that the live cut is stale.
